previous_target_history_source: Profitability: completed past years use their OWN annual GOS in forecast-origin-bounded Denton with frozen Train/Dev blocks; unfinished current year uses the previous year's annual GOS and observed quarterly VA/GO. All 14 profitability history features use the same forecast-origin view; productivity: original prior-quarter scores from 2006 and equivalent component-derived 2005 history; growth: original prior-quarter score when defined, no invented 2005 growth. All sources latest revised official values.
profitability_history_completed_year_pol: Denton fitted only to annual GOS and quarterly VA from completed years strictly before the predicted year, freezing each completed Train/Dev/Test split block at its boundary
profitability_history_current_year_polic: Previous year's annual GOS/mean VA times already-observed current-year quarterly VA divided by nominal gross output
target_feature_observation_policy: Every row t uses only information through t-1; all rolling and peer calculations are strictly lagged; insufficient early history remains NaN without backfilling
gos_quarterly_method: first-difference proportional Denton, current-VA SAAR indicator; Train/Val/Test annual blocks frozen sequentially, with boundary-ratio anchor

raw_axis_definitions.profitability: quarterly imputed GOS / quarterly nominal gross output
raw_axis_definitions.productivity: quarterly real value added (million 2017 dollars, SAAR) / quarterly mean employment (thousand people); funds_trusts uses BEA 523+525 VA / CES 523+525 employment
raw_axis_definitions.growth: quarterly real gross output / same quarter previous year - 1

target_scores: fixed Train-only pooled 59-industry Min-Max, 2006Q1–2019Q4; held-out Val/Test use unchanged bounds, without clipping

funds_trusts_productivity_correction.numerator: BEA securities real VA + BEA funds/trusts real VA

target_mean_timeseries.mean_method: arithmetic mean over all 59 industries, separately for each quarter and scored target
